jobs.prompt: A clean, professional infographic diagram on a very light warm orange tinted background, subtle peachy tone. Flat design, modern tech style. The diagram is titled 'Context7: Smart Documentation for AI Agents' in bold dark text at the top center. At the top center there is a row of three rounded rectangles labeled 'Claude Code', 'GPT Codex', 'Gemini CLI' with small code bracket icons, connected by a downward arrow to a large rounded box labeled 'AI Model' with a subtitle 'Training data cutoff — limited knowledge'. Below the model box, two distinct paths branch out left and right with clear arrows. LEFT PATH (dimmed, crossed out or faded): Arrow goes down to a Google search icon with label 'Web Search', then to messy scattered elements labeled 'Ads', 'Outdated docs', 'PR articles', 'Irrelevant results' in a cluttered cloud shape, with a red X or warning icon. RIGHT PATH (highlighted with orange accent): Arrow goes down to a clean rounded rectangle labeled 'Context7 MCP Server' with a checkmark, then three neat bullet boxes flowing down: 'Token-efficient retrieval', 'Always up-to-date docs', 'JSON & Markdown format'. At the bottom of the right path, a clean document icon with a green checkmark labeled 'Accurate, current documentation delivered to model'. The entire top-left corner area and top-right corner area are kept completely empty with just the consistent light background, no elements placed there. Minimal flat vector style, thin lines, simple geometric icons, very clean layout with generous whitespace, no photorealism, no 3D effects, pure infographic diagram.

A clean, modern infographic diagram with a very subtle light warm orange wash background. Flat design, minimal tech illustration style. Title at top center in clean dark sans-serif font: 'Why Context7 Matters'. The diagram uses a horizontal split layout. On the LEFT side, labeled 'Without Context7' in gray text: A simplified AI agent icon at top sends a search query arrow to a globe/browser icon labeled 'Google Search'. Below that, scattered messy rectangles in muted gray tones represent search results labeled 'ads', 'blog spam', 'outdated v2 docs', 'Stack Overflow 2019'. A dashed arrow leads down to a confused robot face icon with a question mark. On the RIGHT side, labeled 'With Context7' in orange (#ff5b0a) text: The same AI agent icon at top sends a clean arrow to a neat hexagonal node labeled 'Context7 MCP'. Below that, three clean organized document cards flow down: '1. Finds exact docs needed', '2. Always current version', '3. Markdown/JSON native format'. A solid arrow leads down to a happy robot face with a checkmark, next to a clean code window icon labeled 'Quality code output'. A subtle vertical dashed line separates left and right halves. Top-left corner and top-right corner are completely empty with just the consistent background. Flat vector infographic style, no photorealism, no gradients, clean geometric shapes, generous whitespace, thin consistent line weight throughout.

A clean, professional infographic diagram on a very light warm orange tinted background, subtle peachy tone. Flat design, modern tech style. Title at top center in bold dark text: 'Direct Connection vs. Middleman'. The diagram is split into two clear halves by a subtle vertical line. LEFT HALF labeled 'Direct Connection' with a green or orange accent: Three horizontal rows, each showing a direct clean arrow from maker to tool to user. Row 1: Anthropic logo circle → thick solid arrow → 'Claude Code' rectangle → arrow → happy user icon. Row 2: OpenAI logo circle → thick solid arrow → 'GPT Codex' rectangle → arrow → happy user icon. Row 3: Google logo circle → thick solid arrow → 'Gemini CLI' rectangle → arrow → happy user icon. Below these rows, bullet points: 'Same engineers build model + tool', 'Direct line to the model', 'Best prompting optimization'. The path is visually longer and more convoluted with multiple hops. Below: 'Extra layer of abstraction', 'Black box infrastructure', 'Expensive hosting markup'. Top-left corner and top-right corner completely empty. Flat vector infographic, minimal style, clean layout, no photorealism, thin lines, simple icons.

A clean, modern infographic diagram with very subtle light warm orange wash background. Minimal flat design. Title at top center: 'Who Builds Your AI Coding Tool?' in clean dark sans-serif font. The diagram uses a visual metaphor of distance and connection quality. TOP SECTION labeled 'Direct from the Source' with an orange (#ff5b0a) accent line: Three pairs shown horizontally, each connected by a glowing straight thick line resembling a fiber optic cable. Pair 1: 'Anthropic' circle connected to 'Claude Code' rounded rectangle. Pair 2: 'OpenAI' circle connected to 'GPT Codex' rounded rectangle. Pair 3: 'Google' circle connected to 'Gemini CLI' rounded rectangle. Below each pair a small label: 'Same team, direct access'. BOTTOM SECTION labeled 'Through a Middleman' in gray text: Shows a user icon on the left, connected by a long winding dotted path that goes through multiple intermediary boxes: 'Middleman Service' (with logos suggestion of Lovable, Bolt, Replit), then 'API wrapper', then 'Token markup $$$', finally reaching 'AI Model' far on the right. The winding path is visually contrasted with the straight clean lines above. Small labels along the path: 'black box', 'no direct access', 'extra cost'.
